title: please add color code list 🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼
body:
I’ve been enjoying this app a lot, and it has become an essential part of my daily routine. It helps me stay organized and reminds me of the many tasks I need to complete each day. The simple and user-friendly design makes planning much easier.

One feature I would really love to see is the ability to assign different colors to individual lists, similar to Google Calendar. Color-coding would make it much easier to organize tasks, distinguish between categories at a glance, and improve the overall planning experience.

I truly appreciate the work your team has put into developing this app, and I hope you’ll continue expanding its features in future updates. I believe this small addition would make a big difference for many users. Thank you for creating such a wonderful application, and I look forward to seeing how it continues to improve.
